name: Ammora
steps: Add GIWA Sepolia to a browser wallet such as MetaMask. GIWA's docs give chain ID 91342 and the RPC address https://sepolia-rpc.giwa.io.
Get GIWA Sepolia test ETH from one of the faucets linked on the waitlist page.
Open the waitlist join page , connect your wallet, sign the message and enter an email address. Signing sends no transaction.
Choose your X account carefully, then do the one-time X tasks. The privacy notice says "A different X account may replace the linked account once", so you get one change.

Each day, use Supply to deposit at least 0.001 test ETH. Once a week, from Monday 00:00 UTC, publish the prepared post on X. Warning Posting the same promotional text again and again can get an X account restricted. Ammora cut the post to once a week after participants reported restrictions and suspensions.
Check the Boost page for the daily roulette, bridge and swap activities. Season 2 of the Boost event ended on 16 October 2026, and no new season had been announced by 18 October.
Check your rank on the leaderboard and follow the Telegram channel for announcements.
what: Ammora has announced no token or airdrop. Its free testnet waitlist on GIWA gives points toward an undefined final reward. Steps and risks.
behind: Nobody is named. No person, company, investor or funding appears on Ammora's site, docs or Telegram channel, and the contact given is a Gmail address. GIWA itself is a real network from Dunamu, with its mainnet still in development. Get the next airdrop first We post new guides, claim openings and deadlines on Telegram and X. Join our Telegram Follow on X
costs: Nothing in real money. The missions use test ETH from faucets, and there is no purchase, mint or fee. The cost is your time and a daily post on your X account.
risks: No terms of use are published, and there is no country list, age limit or identity rule. The campaign collects your wallet address, email address and X account, and the leaderboard shows shortened wallet addresses in public. The project is very new. Its X account dates from 24 August 2026 and its domain from two days later. The size it reports is hard to square with its audience: the waitlist page
